hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that routes liquidity through Euler lending vaults instead of standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. Intercepts all swaps in `beforeSwap`, computes quotes via a proprietary curve invariant, and deposits/withdraws assets to/from Euler vaults, fully replacing the pool's AMM logic via `BeforeSwapDelta`.
